pages.notes: Photograph of the exterior of a classified document folder/envelope with a small cover label, but the label text is too small and at an oblique angle to be reliably captured by OCR.

Mostly blank administrative page with handwritten classification markings (CONFIDENTIAL/SECRET stamps with strikethroughs), redaction marks, and document reference numbers (020249 30014, S7P-1(126)); minimal text content suitable for OCR.

Typewritten UFO incident report form with dark photocopy background. OCR has significant character recognition errors: garbled line numbers at start, date truncated (198 instead of 1948), time misread (5301 vs 5101), and systematic misspellings (observer→obsorvor, Stehbiel→Srehbiel, etc.), though overall structure and most content is captured.

Typewritten government document with mostly accurate OCR; errors include 'narthern' (northern), 'smuige' (smudge), and misread 'M' and 'N' as quote marks ('exico, 'ebraska), likely due to dark scan and typewriter font artifacts.

Typewritten testimony document with legible scan but moderate OCR errors including word concatenations (towardthe, amd), misspellings (altitule, hear), and spurious artifacts at the beginning (= us eo é e A). Marginal stamps visible on left side.

Typewritten 1948 Army memo about a meteor explosion near Norcatur, Kansas; OCR captures most content but misreads several digits (1948→1918/19h8/198), substitutes 'é' for '8' in dates, converts 'line' to 'lime', and has minor character/spacing issues throughout.

Mostly accurate OCR with several errors: '+f' misread as 'If', 'illimunated' instead of 'illuminated', 'mexplained' (likely for 'unexplained'), and possible '2h' for '21' in date; document shows age-related darkening but remains clearly readable throughout.

Typewritten letter with clear content discussing lunar observations and signed by Norman Garrett Markham; dark microfilm scan quality prevented OCR from capturing any of the ~250+ words visible to human eyes, despite text being legible.

Typewritten memo about UAP sightings with reasonable structural capture but systematic errors in dates (1947→197, 1948→19148), file references (SIGDE-M-1→SIGGE-u-1), and symbol confusion (° → %, : omitted). Most text present but numerous digit/character substitutions throughout.

Aged typewritten page with several OCR errors: '):00' misread as '4:00', '1947' truncated to '197', '14 July' become '1, July', 'OAKLAND' misread as 'QAKIAND', and 'together' as 'togehter'; extra 'plea' at start; mostly readable despite aging but errors affect data accuracy.

Typewritten declassified document with moderate OCR errors in numbers: coordinates read as '3 degrees'/'12 degrees' instead of '13 degrees'/'124 degrees', dates corrupted ('19,7' for '1947', 'November 2), 197' for 'November 24, 1947'), 'latitude' read as '1 titude', and '400 yards' as '00 yards'.

Typewritten memo with good overall text capture, but several character misreads: 'June 2)' should be 'June 24', 'inoon' should be 'moon', 'Pr,' should be 'Dr.', and a stray 'OG' artifact. Dark microfilm scan quality reduced OCR accuracy on specific characters.
Microfilm scan of typewritten letter with good legibility; OCR captured nearly all text but has minor character recognition errors ('1j' for '14', likely 'foal' for 'real').

Typewritten page from microfilm scan with clear readability; OCR captured the main text well but made character substitution errors (well-to-dO instead of well-to-do, t+ instead of th, récovered accent mark) and picked up formatting artifacts at the beginning (eS, underscore, tte).

Typewritten government document with good readability, but OCR has multiple character errors: ')?50' should be '4:50', 'suidenly' → 'suddenly', 'ceriter' → 'center', 'ani' → 'and', 'orton' → 'Norton', 'andthat' → 'and that', 'clow' → 'cloud', 'lowi' → 'loud'. Dark scan with visible copy stamps contributes to OCR confusion on numbers and certain letter patterns.
Typewritten government document page with incident testimony; OCR captures nearly all text but has character-level errors (ani→and, clouw→cloud, t ought→thought, vicinity'of→vicinity of).

Typewritten government checklist form with redaction marks and age-related fading; OCR captured all 26 line items but contains consistent character-level errors throughout (e.g., 'observer' → 'obsorvor', 'Speed' → 'Speod', 'Altitude' → 'Altitudo', 'Multi-colored' → 'Malti-golered') likely due to document degradation and overlapping censorship marks.

Typewritten government incident report with numerous OCR character errors: 'buge'→huge, '4s'→45, 'Wat'→W at, 'ément'→Bombardment, 'lmge'→huge, 'Colorads'→Colorado, 'Cerl'→Carl, and truncated military designations. Most text captured but requires correction.

Typewritten UFO checklist form with RESTRICTED stamps; OCR captures most content but has notable errors: 'Howard' misread as 'wos ey', 'objects' as 'chijeete', 'detected' as 'dotectea', and 'Name' as 'Mame'. Dark, faded photocopy scan quality degrades accuracy on some letter recognition.

Dark microfilm scan of Air Force UFO sighting checklist form with visible RESTRICTED markings; OCR has significant garbled text in the opening section and inconsistent word accuracy, but captures most of the numbered form entries and key data fields.

Page contains a typewritten UAP sighting report with RESTRICTED markings and visible redaction circles, but OCR captured zero text despite the content being legible—likely failed due to low contrast and faded image quality.

UFO incident checklist form with significant OCR errors in letter recognition (observer→obsorvor, objects→objocts, place→placo) likely due to faded typewriter text and dark photocopy scan, but most field content and structure captured correctly.

Dark declassified document with RESTRICTED stamps; OCR captured overall structure and meaning but contains multiple character-level errors (e.g., 'pron tie etd' for 'observed', 'Belmont, ar ne' for 'Belmont, N.C.', 'Hlectric' for 'Electric', 'Tesponsible' for 'responsible'), primarily affecting rare letter combinations and low-contrast passages.

Microfilm scan of classified UFO checklist form; OCR captured most form fields correctly but produced garbage characters at start and occasional misreadings (N/S vs w/S) due to dark background and age of source.

Military memo from Fourth Air Force Intelligence (March 1948) regarding flying disc investigation. Typewritten classified document with clear content but multiple OCR errors including 'bromish-white' for 'brownish-white', '1918' for '1948', '& March' for '8 March', 'Haberfelde' as 'Haber felde', and misreading 'E.' as '=' in a name; handwritten marks on margins also captured as spurious symbols.

Page contains clearly visible typewritten text with evaluation table and CONFIDENTIAL markings, but OCR captured nothing despite legible content; photocopy degradation and dark scan likely contributed to OCR failure.

Typewritten UFO incident checklist with RESTRICTED stamps; OCR severely garbled the opening (line numbers/formatting artifacts rendered as random characters), then improved but contains persistent errors (cuts off '1948' to '198', renders 'Incident #107' as 'seesdone F107', various field character misreadings).

Typewritten checklist form with RESTRICTED stamps; OCR has multiple character substitution errors (19h8→1948, Namo→Name, Numbor→Number, Woather→Weather, Effoct→Effect) and missed digits (110 reported as 10), but overall structure and most content captured correctly.

Incident summary form with typewritten and filled responses; OCR captured structure and some fields correctly but introduced numerous garbling errors (e.g., 'Amp@ating' instead of 'Appearing', 'fram' instead of 'from'), struggles with faded/aged text and handwritten elements.

Typewritten military report on aged paper with redaction marks; OCR captures the document structure and content flow but contains numerous character-level errors (e.g., '12% §2*' for '12° E21', 'obj ct' for 'object', '@pproximately', 'resesbled', 'mide', 'festures', 'wes') that would require manual review.

Government UFO incident checklist form with RESTRICTED stamps; OCR captured document structure but made critical field errors including Number of objects (OCR '2K' vs actual '1'), Time in sight (OCR 'W/S' vs actual 'N/S'), and multiple yes/no field misreadings, with corrupted text fragments at beginning.

Typewritten government document on aged paper with RESTRICTED stamps. OCR captured all text but made two character substitution errors: 'appesred' for 'appeared' and 'appesrance' for 'appearance', likely due to the faded/noisy scan quality.

Typewritten UFO report form with numerous OCR errors: 'Dato' for 'Date', 'Shio' for 'Ohio', 'obsorvor' for 'observer', 'Shapo' for 'Shape', 'Woathor' for 'Weather', 'dotected' for 'detected'. Typewritten declassified document with RESTRICTED stamps; OCR captured all text but introduced several character-level errors including word boundary artifacts (hyphens/underscores for spaces) and letter substitutions (+t for It, lt for It).
